title: Kuru (Monad) — unverified ERC-1967 custody clones (AccountCore + MarginAccount): every value path self/owner/authority-gated; E-U $0
closed_reasons: AccountCore 0x264123a9B96Cc1193944cC25C188f1bD3dFa670e (EIP-1967 proxy, 141-byte code) -> unverified impl 0xb52debad718730ee0a4c12c28e70d346dbcc9e5b (33,512 B). withdraw(uint40,address,uint256,address) requires msg.sender == account owner or an authorised signer with ACCOUNT_PERMISSION_WITHDRAW; live eth_call from a fresh address reverts 0x82b42900 Unauthorized() even against funded account id 26, while the SAME calldata from the real owner (0x9daba38229f593d90f99062bb18ed41f57b16ce8) succeeds.

AccountCore.fulfillApprovedWithdrawal requires caller == withdrawalAuthority (0x81f6f37d079b88fdd6c5f674b3f328eee028fe56) AND the root owner's EIP-712 ApprovedWithdrawal signature with nonce/epoch/deadline checks and pre-transfer nonce consumption; a fresh caller with sig=0x reverts.

AccountCore admin selectors setAuthority/setWithdrawalAuthority/toggleProtocolState/upgradeToAndCall and createSubaccount(for another owner) all revert 0x82b42900 Unauthorized() from a fresh address; createSubaccount for the caller's own root account succeeds but moves zero value.

MarginAccount 0x2A68ba1833cDf93fa9Da1EEbd7F46242aD8E90c5 -> unverified impl 0x351525073afa933720329756716fcf7d741e7ff0 (5,174 B): withdraw(uint256,address) debits _msgSender()'s own balances only (fresh caller reverts 0xf4d678b8 InsufficientBalance()); batchWithdrawMaxTokens is a no-op for a zero-balance caller; debitUser/creditUser/creditUsersEncoded/creditFee are gated by verifiedMarket[msg.sender]; deposit credits a named user but pulls tokens from msg.sender.

ERC-2771 is not a spoofing vector: MarginAccount.isTrustedForwarder(0x974E61BBa9C4704E8Bcc1923fdC3527B41323FAA)==true, and the VERIFIED KuruForwarder impl 0xbf6cc109c6ebca4b28e3e51fd8798294599cfe2a only forwards after verify() recovers the EIP-712 signer and requires signer==req.from, with monotone nonces and an allowed-interface allow-list; a forged request reverts SignatureMismatch.

The pass-4 'unreadable source' premise is largely resolved: the deployed AccountCore selector set corresponds to the official public Kuru SDK accountCoreAbi (github.com/Kuru-Labs/ts-sdk), the DEX contracts are public (Kuru-Labs/Kuru-contracts-dex-public), and the exact AccountCore withdrawal policy (src/account/AccountCore.sol, revision 62c478b05dfe936c87fa95f35d89307d4a2d303c) is formally verified by the independent lfglabs-dev/ethereum-verification-benchmark case kuru/withdrawal_limit (8 spec groups + PolicyBundle, proofs complete).
The pass-4 balance figure is stale: AccountCore + MarginAccount now hold 5,162,222.19 MON (not 6,150,375) and additionally 270,275.59 USDC the lead did not count.

The AccountCore and MarginAccount IMPLEMENTATIONS are not verified on the explorer; ABI identity is established from Kuru's official SDK + live selector scanning, not a byte-exact recompile (the exact source revision is not public).

The Lean formal model pins revision 62c478b and does not mechanise Solidity->Lean refinement, bytecode or storage layout; the deployed AccountCore is a NEWER revision (adds sub-accounts, authorizeAccountSigner, approveBuilder, loseWager). Re-test if the impl changes or withdrawalsFrozen/protocolPaused flip.

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Kuru's $379.7k of custodied MON+USDC on Monad: both unverified ERC-1967 clones are self-scoped/owner/authority-gated (fresh caller gets Unauthorized()/InsufficientBalance(), the real owner's identical withdraw succeeds), the ERC-2771 relay is EIP-712 signature-verified, and the AccountCore withdrawal policy is independently formally verified.
